disruptions.basis: Key Bridge collapse 2024-03-26 ~01:28 EDT = 05:28 UTC (config uses 05:30 UTC) to the start of the documented full-channel reopening day, 2024-06-10 (USACE: full Fort McHenry channel restored, announced 10 Jun 2024). PHASES NOT MODELLED: the shipped sim vocabulary applies one capacity_loss level per step window; stacking adjacent windows at one node to fake a phase curve would compose berth scaling in ways the shipped reaction model does not document. Pre-registered choice: full closure to the full-reopening date, stated here in advance.

Grounding 2021-03-23T05:40Z (BBC via Sentinel Vision EVT-839) to refloat 2021-03-29T13:05Z (Boskalis press release, 29 Mar 2021) = 6 d 7 h 25 m = 6.31 d. Full closure: the canal was physically blocked by the grounded vessel.

Carrier suspensions of Red Sea transits began 2023-12-15/16 (Maersk 15 Dec, Hapag-Lloyd 15 Dec, MSC 16 Dec, CMA CGM 16 Dec — Reuters). In the sim's reaction vocabulary a suspension is a behavioural closure: partial capacity_loss only slows approaches in the shipped model and can never produce a diversion, while the documented behaviour was diversion. Pre-registered translation: full closure at Bab el-Mandeb for the window 2023-12-15 to 2024-02-29 (76 d). NOTE the deliberate divergence from the chain replay's config (capacity_cut 0.7 in the chain engine's capacity vocabulary, sourced from the UNCTAD gross-tonnage fall): each engine is fed the shock in its own vocabulary; the cross-check in the scorecard compares the two delay pictures as found.

global.engine: shipped constants only (the shipped server/sim); no constant, threshold, or config may be adjusted after the pre-registration to improve a grade
global.twin: every run is paired with its undisrupted twin: same graph, same derivation (seed/start/horizon), empty disruption set; delay and flow comparisons are disrupted-vs-twin
global.weather_note: Weather OFF (None) for all runs: the shipped demo-run discipline, and no historical weather snapshot exists in this system for 2021/2024 windows. Not a tuning choice; stated in advance.
